```{r}
#| results: asis
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

PATH_INTERVALS <- "../scoring/ss_to_raw_intervals.csv"
PATH_TR_PARAMS <- "../scoring/TR_total_norm_params.csv"

intervals <- readr::read_csv(PATH_INTERVALS, show_col_types = FALSE)
tr_pars   <- readr::read_csv(PATH_TR_PARAMS, show_col_types = FALSE)

# --- SS boundaries in z for round(10 + 3*z), clamped 1..19
ss_bounds_z <- function(ss) {
  stopifnot(length(ss) == 1, ss >= 1, ss <= 19)
  if (ss == 1)  return(c(-Inf, (1.5 - 10)/3))
  if (ss == 19) return(c((18.5 - 10)/3, Inf))
  c(((ss - 0.5) - 10)/3, ((ss + 0.5) - 10)/3)
}

# --- TR total algorithm helper (mean item SS interval yielding each TR total SS)
tr_total_algo <- tr_pars %>%
  select(age, mu, sigma) %>%
  tidyr::expand_grid(ss_1_19 = 1:19) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    ztot_lo = ss_bounds_z(ss_1_19)[1],
    ztot_hi = ss_bounds_z(ss_1_19)[2],
    zmean_lo = mu + sigma * ztot_lo,
    zmean_hi = mu + sigma * ztot_hi,
    raw_min = 10 + 3 * zmean_lo,
    raw_max = 10 + 3 * zmean_hi,
    raw_min = pmax(1, raw_min),
    raw_max = pmin(19, raw_max)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    measure = "TR_TOTAL_ALGO_MEAN_ITEM_SS",
    age = age,
    ss_1_19 = ss_1_19,
    raw_min = raw_min,
    raw_max = raw_max
  )

# Totals only:
# - Remove TR items and raw-average TR
intervals_tot <- intervals %>%
  filter(!str_starts(measure, "PercDevAbs_TR_")) %>%
  filter(measure != "AverageDevAbs_TR") %>%
  bind_rows(tr_total_algo)

label_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~measure, ~label, ~ord,
  "TR_TOTAL_ALGO_MEAN_ITEM_SS", "TR totale (media SS item)", 1,
  "TD", "TD ratio", 2,
  "TE_Barca_dd", "TE Barca", 3,
  "TE_Ladro_dd", "TE Ladro", 4,
  "TEdd_Mean",   "TE mean",  5,

  "OTm_orientation", "Child orient", 6,
  "OTm_management",  "Child manage", 7,
  "OTm_total",       "Child total",  8,
  "QST_parent_total",  "Parent total",  9,
  "QST_teacher_total", "Teacher total", 10
)

intervals_tot <- intervals_tot %>%
  inner_join(label_map, by = "measure")

# Cell formatting
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)

cell_string <- function(measure, lo, hi) {
  digits <- 2
  if (str_starts(measure, "OTm_") || str_starts(measure, "QST_")) digits <- 0
  if (is.infinite(hi)) return(paste0(fmt_num(lo, digits), "+"))
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(lo, hi))) return(fmt_num(lo, digits))
  paste0(fmt_num(lo, digits), " - ", fmt_num(hi, digits))
}

intervals_tot2 <- intervals_tot %>%
  mutate(cell = mapply(cell_string, measure, raw_min, raw_max, SIMPLIFY = TRUE)) %>%
  select(age, ss_1_19, ord, label, cell)

ages <- sort(unique(intervals_tot2$age))
ss_rows <- tibble(ss_1_19 = 19:1)

for (a in ages) {
  dat_a <- intervals_tot2 %>% filter(age == a)

  cat("\\begin{landscape}\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("\\section*{Et\\`a %s anni}\n\n", a))

  labels <- dat_a %>% arrange(ord) %>% pull(label) %>% unique()

  tab <- dat_a %>%
    filter(label %in% labels) %>%
    select(ss_1_19, label, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = cell, values_fill = "-") %>%
    right_join(ss_rows, by = "ss_1_19") %>%
    arrange(desc(ss_1_19)) %>%
    mutate(across(-ss_1_19, ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, "-")))

  cat(as.character(
    kable(tab, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "c",
          col.names = c("SS", names(tab)[-1])) |>
      kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 8)
  ))
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("\\subsection*{Come calcolare TR totale (in breve)}\n\n")
  cat("\\noindent Converti ciascun item TR (2--12 s) nel relativo SS, calcola la media dei 11 SS (con decimali), poi usa la colonna \\textbf{“TR totale (media SS item)”} per ottenere lo SS totale.\n\n")

  cat("\\end{landscape}\n")
  cat("\\newpage\n\n")
}
```
